## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible or maintenance outcome.

## Why

Explain the problem this solves and any important scope boundary.

## Verification

List the repository-required checks and focused proofs you ran, with their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the repository's local `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and CI contract where present.
- [ ] I ran the applicable required project checks and any focused proof needed for this change.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.
- [ ] I updated public documentation when behavior or support expectations changed.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, secrets, signed URLs, WordPress runtime state, customer data, private source, private repository or site identities, non-public release assets, full production logs, private workbench material, Dex identifiers, vulnerability details, or other sensitive information.
- [ ] I understand that review does not guarantee merge or release; a maintainer makes those decisions separately.
